brief: Circuit testing and verification log drafted from field notes for a newly installed 100 A subpanel feeder at a bank branch.

# Subpanel Feeder Continuity and Voltage Drop Inspection Log

On 03/12/2026, Marcus Vance completed continuity and operational load checks on the 120/240 V feeder serving teller panel LP-2 at Apex National Bank. Phase A measured 120.4 V line-to-neutral at 0.18 ohms loop resistance, while Phase B measured 120.6 V with 0.22 ohms loop resistance. Under an applied test load of 40.0 A per phase, the line-to-neutral voltage drop for Phase A calculates to 9.2 V across the run. All conductor insulation resistances verified above 50 megohms at 1,000 V DC.

errors.quote: calculates to 9.2 V across the run
errors.explanation: By Ohm's law (V = I * R), an applied load of 40.0 A across Phase A's 0.18 ohms loop resistance produces a voltage drop of 7.2 V (40.0 * 0.18 = 7.2), not 9.2 V.
errors.fix: calculates to 7.2 V across the run
